audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with both the packet chart and the already-audited mirror at two rows: Level 6 was 'Skill' and 2+ items was 'Heimerdinger'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Skill/Heimerdinger x5/Kassadin, and the kassadin__heimerdinger mirror explicitly flipped 2+ items to Kassadin in both layers while leaving the earlier stages with Heimerdinger. A rank-1 Riftwalk is a 500-range blink on a 5s cooldown against a 970 grenade and 1325 rockets, so Level 6 is still Heimerdinger's; rank-3 Riftwalk at 2s past a two-item Kassadin is not.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side/win[4] Skill -> Heimerdinger; phases[6].side/win[6] Heimerdinger -> Kassadin, proposed as matched full+content pairs with the ratings and whys moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and the cooldown block carried no real numbers, and spikes[2] asserted 'physical-natured beam pressure'.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's turret beams are magic damage, so Void Stone's magic-damage reduction blunts them rather than being irrelevant — the exact opposite of what the text told the reader. Riftwalk's 5/3.5/2s spread, CH-2's flat 11s and UPGRADE!!!'s 100/85/70s are the numbers that make the timing advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Void Stone reduction written into spikes[2] and spikes[3] and into late; Riftwalk 5s->2s, the flat 11s grenade and the 100s ultimate written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields (mid-tier prose: early, late, whys[6], spikes[3], wants.foe[1]) told the reader Kassadin's Q silences. Riot's Null Sphere text has no silence — it deals damage, INTERRUPTS CHANNELS, and leaves a magic-absorbing shield. Two fields also called Void Stone a 'passive magic shield'; it is flat magic damage reduction plus unit-collision immunity.
audit.why: Advice built on a silence that does not exist mistrains the player: he is told he cannot drop the grenade when in fact he can. The real interaction is the shield eating a beam volley and Void Stone taxing every point of magic damage Heimerdinger deals.
audit.corrected: Silence removed everywhere and replaced with the channel-interrupt and the shield; Void Stone restated as magic-damage reduction; Nether Blade named as the auto-attack-reset burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions claims Null Sphere is itself a channel that Heimerdinger's grenade cancels.
audit.why: That is a derived-flag misfire. Riot's text says Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels; nothing says it is one. Per the standing rule, the description beats the flag, so the claim was not written to the page.
audit.corrected: Not asserted. Recorded here and in notes.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kassadin's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: A rank-1 Riftwalk is a 500-range blink on 5s, not burst — UPGRADE!!! banks a wider grenade stun and you still hold the lane.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kassadin carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in and it flips: rank-3 Riftwalk blinks past the nest every 2s and one-shots you. Carry threat 9.5/10 — close first.

edits.before: At level 1 you have only one turret and no grenade stun, but Kassadin is just as feeble — no waveclear and a passive shield that does nothing offensively — so the contact window is a wash.
edits.after: At level 1 you have one turret and no grenade stun, but Kassadin is feebler — no waveclear, and Void Stone only cuts magic damage — so your turret out-trades his 650 Null Sphere poke.

edits.before: He out-scales hard: two-item Riftwalk blinks past your turrets and his Q-silence-into-burst kills your immobile yordle before the beams matter — his window, not yours.
edits.after: He out-scales hard: rank-3 Riftwalk blinks past your turrets every 2s and Null Sphere into Nether Blade kills your immobile yordle before the beams matter — his window.

edits.before: Lost Chapter / Rod of Ages Kassadin still can't burst through three turrets, and his magic shield doesn't stop the physical-natured beam pressure — keep sieging his tower while his single item does nothing for the duel.
edits.after: Lost Chapter / Rod of Ages Kassadin still can't burst through three turrets, and Null Sphere's shield only eats one beam volley — keep sieging his tower while Void Stone's magic reduction and one item still lose the duel.

edits.before: Riftwalk plus a second AP item lets Kassadin blink straight onto you past the nest, Q-silence you so you can't drop the grenade, and one-shot your immobile yordle before the beams add up — his exact win condition.
edits.after: Riftwalk plus a second AP item lets Kassadin blink onto you every 2s past the nest, and Void Stone's magic-damage reduction blunts the beams while Nether Blade one-shots your immobile yordle — his exact win condition.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the saddest early laners in the game — no waveclear, a passive magic shield that does nothing to push, and no Riftwalk until 6 — so once your second turret and the slowing electron beams are up around level 2-3 you simply wall him off the wave. Plant the nest on his side of the lane and let the beams tax every last-hit he reaches for. Don't overstep into his Q silence range at level 1 when you only have one turret and no grenade stun, but the moment the full setup is down he physically cannot trade into the buildings.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the saddest early laners in the game — no waveclear, Void Stone only cuts magic damage taken, and no Riftwalk until 6 — so once your second turret and the slowing electron beams are up around level 2-3 you simply wall him off the wave. Plant the nest on his side of the lane and let the beams tax every last-hit he reaches for. Stay outside Null Sphere's 650 range at level 1 when you have one turret and no grenade stun; after that his 650 poke cannot answer three buildings and 1325-range rockets.

edits.before: Be honest with yourself: Kassadin is a hard scaler and the clock is his ally. Once he has two AP items, Riftwalk blinks past your turret nest, his Q silences you so you can't even drop the grenade, and his burst one-shots your low-HP yordle before the beams matter — and his passive magic shield blunts your damage on the way in. Your turrets stop mattering the instant he ignores them and jumps straight on you. Cash your lead before then: siege his tower, deny his items, and force the map to end on your three-turret siege spike rather than letting this reach his power curve.
edits.after: Be honest with yourself: Kassadin is a hard scaler and the clock is his ally. Once he has two AP items, Riftwalk blinks past your turret nest every 2s, Null Sphere interrupts anything you are channelling, and his burst one-shots your low-HP yordle before the beams matter — while Void Stone cuts the magic damage you deal on the way in. Your turrets stop mattering the instant he ignores them and jumps straight on you. Cash your lead before then: siege his tower, deny his items, and force the map to end on your three-turret siege spike rather than letting this reach his power curve.

edits.before: Use the Q silence + magic shield to eat your W rockets and turret poke without dying, riding it out to 6
edits.after: Use Null Sphere's shield and Void Stone's magic cut to eat your W rockets and turret poke, riding it out to 6

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — 5s at rank 1 and only 2s at rank 3. Kill him before it scales. - CH-2 grenade: a flat 11s at every rank. - UPGRADE!!!: 100s at rank 1 — kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spread them — one Riftwalk should never land outside all three beams.

notes: Null Sphere does NOT silence. Five fields on this page said it did; all corrected. The kit's 'channel: interruptible' flag on Null Sphere is a tooltip-parse misfire (Riot's text says it INTERRUPTS channels), so the brief's missingInteractions 'your grenade cancels his Q channel' claim was NOT written to the page. Void Stone is magic-damage reduction plus unit-collision immunity, not a shield — this matters because Heimerdinger's turret beams are magic damage, so his passive taxes your entire kit. Level chart flipped at two rows to agree with the packet and the kassadin__heimerdinger mirror, proposed as matched full+content pairs.
